# ClientPad

> ClientPad is open-source infrastructure for WhatsApp-first lead capture, client workflows, API keys, usage tracking, and operator dashboards.

## Product

- [ClientPad Home](https://clientpad.xyz/index.md): Product overview, package links, and quick start
- [About ClientPad](https://clientpad.xyz/about.md): Mission, positioning, and open-source business model
- [ClientPad Cloud](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/clientpad-cloud.md): Hosted gateway, dashboard, usage tracking, and billing-ready operations
- [Pricing](https://clientpad.xyz/pricing.md): Open-source and hosted Cloud pricing model

## Documentation

- [Docs Home](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/index.md): Documentation entry point
- [Quickstart](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/quickstart.md): Install and create the first lead
- [SDK](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/sdk.md): TypeScript SDK usage
- [WhatsApp Magic](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/whatsapp-magic.md): WhatsApp lead capture, inbox, payments, and pipeline operations
- [Public API](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/public-api.md): REST API and TypeScript SDK usage
- [Self-hosting](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/self-hosting.md): Run ClientPad with your own PostgreSQL and deployment
- [Open-Source Architecture](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/open-source.md): Packages, database approach, auth, and deployment model
- [Deployment](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/deployment.md): Domain and Netlify deployment guide
- [Troubleshooting](https://clientpad.xyz/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common live-mode, DNS, API key, and webhook fixes
